name: Sarah Ashton
source:
[url=/c175728]Flynn[/url]'s first true love. She was the most caring person in the world, and taught him a lot about what it means to really care about something or someone. She struggled with many aspects of her life and, despite having peoplpe that truly loved her and wanted to help, she decided to take her own life.

[Edited from in-game description]
